svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 09/12 Fog Rolling In (Common)
svg.desc: Summer afternoons the fog climbs in from the ocean and swallows the houses one row at a time. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
